about.titleHighlight: Jaguar XF XFR 5.0 Supercharged V8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The XFR was the flagship performance variant of the X250-generation Jaguar XF, produced from 2011 to 2015. It uses the AJ133S — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 that was Jaguar's most powerful engine of the era, producing 510 bhp. The same engine family (AJ133/AJ133S) was used across the XJ, XK and F-Type ranges of the period, and the X250 XFR is explicitly named in a US class-action lawsuit covering the timing chain tensioner design flaw on 2012–2014 models. The XFR was discontinued when the XF moved to the X260 generation in 2015, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every XFR still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ133S engines for every XF XFR 5.0 Supercharged V8 on the road.
